name: qa-experimentation
description: Experimentation harness testing: the experiment-sdk-testing umbrella (Statsig, Optimizely, Split.io, Amplitude Experiment, VWO hermetic harnesses), the AB-test validity checklist, the experiment-results interpreter (peeking + guardrail methodology in its references), and sample-ratio-mismatch (SRM) detection. Distinct from qa-shift-right/feature-flag-experiment-validator (validates experiment results); this plugin tests the experimentation harness itself (SDK behaviour, assignment integrity, statistical-validity gates).
